Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting school districts with fewer than three thousand students from certain statutes and rules.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school districts with an enrollment of less thanthree thousand students; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.320RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.320RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All school districts with a student enrollment of less thanthree thousand students are exempt from all state statutes and rulesapplicable to school districts and school district boards of directorsexcept as provided in this section. (2) All such school districts may elect to comply with one or moreprovisions of the statutes or rules that are applicable to schooldistricts and school district board of directors. (3) All such school districts shall: (a) Comply with state and federal health, safety, and civil rightslaws applicable to school districts; (b) Participate in nationally normed standardized achievement testsas required in RCW 28A.230.190, 28A.230.193, and 28A.230.230 and the p. 1 SB 5906elementary, middle school, and high school standards and assessmentexaminations as required in RCW 28A.655.060; (c) Employ certificated instructional staff as required in RCW28A.410.010, but may hire noncertificated instructional staff ofunusual competence and in exceptional cases as specified in RCW28A.150.260; (d) Comply with the employee record check requirements in RCW28A.400.303; (e) Be subject to the same financial and audit requirements asother school districts; (f) Comply with the annual performance report under RCW28A.655.110; (g) Follow the performance improvement goals and requirementsadopted by the academic achievement and accountability commission byrule under RCW 28A.655.030; (h) Report at least annually to parents of children enrolled in thedistrict on progress toward the student performance goals specified in(g) of this subsection; and (i) Comply with the open public meetings act in chapter 42.30 RCW;and (j) Comply with chapters 41.56, 41.58, and 41.59 RCW.
